name: Playground
tagline: Spikes: a projection-mapping app in Rust, and an Android harness that tests on a real phone from CI.
description: A scratch repository for experiments before they earn a repository of their own. lumen is a projection-mapping app (egui editor, wgpu renderer, CPU reference renderer with golden-image tests, video and generator sources, cues with crossfades, OSC, MIDI learn, a phone remote, Spout on Windows, headless CLI). The mobile harness is a small Compose app with unit and instrumented tests, built and run on a device by its own workflows.
